description.blurb: S/2020 S 5 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2020 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2020 S 5 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 18.4 million km in 933.88 days. It has an inclination of 48.2° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.220.
